author: ZodiacKnight
quote:
I’ve been a fan of GTA since 3 and I really was excited for this game.

But it’s an overpriced buggy mess. The story is lame. The main characters just don’t do it for me like the previous GTA games. I found their stories boring. 

I liked all the chaos in the previous games. They’ve made changes that have made it unrecognisable compared to it’s predecessors. 

This one to me just seems half baked. But they’ve been baking this for 13 years. 

It makes me feel like the franchise has totally gone as we knew it. I’ll keep playing the classics, and 5. But I doubt I’ll buy another mainline GTA game again.  

Also the frame rate says 30 FPS but it barely manages that. Even the beleaguered Definitive Edition of the original GTA Vice City with all its issues can still reach 60FPS on any PS5 (using performance mode option).  The fact that 6 despite all the money they spent making it can’t go higher than 30 but a remake **** from 2002 can outrun it by double is just embarrassing. 

£90 for this what a waste of money. I feel like I’ve been mugged lol. Either way; this game will be listed as a success cos of all the preorders.  

Give me the OG Vice City anytime rather than this game, seriously  
  
Tommy Vercetti is way more fun to play
